summary.text: Katy Duhigg is a Democrat who has served in the New Mexico Senate since 2021, representing District 10 in Bernalillo County.
Duhigg chairs the Senate Rules Committee and also sits on the Senate Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's member page lists Duhigg's occupation as attorney and a district office in Albuquerque.
Between sessions, Duhigg is co-chair of the Interim Legislative Ethics Committee and a member of the Legislative Council.
